When FIFO reaches near full state
If pause slot is enabled(set to 1)
pause frame only once. But if pause slot is disabled(set to 0)

When pause slot is disabled
column2: if there is no one to handle receive

column1: packets
column2: device FIFO will reach near full state and keep sending

column1: pause frames. That will impact entire local area network.
This issue can be reproduced in Chromebox (not Chromebook) in
developer mode running a test image (and v5.10 kernel):
1) ping -f $CHROMEBOX (from workstation on same local network)
2) run ""powerd_dbus_suspend"" from command line on the $CHROMEBOX
3) ping $ROUTER (wait until ping fails from workstation)
Takes about ~20-30 seconds after step 2 for the local network to
stop working.
Fix this issue by enabling pause slot to only send pause frame once
when FIFO reaches near full state.
